name: S. A. Marney
role: Proprietor of the Stockgrowers' Journal, Miles City
bio: S. A. Marney, nicknamed "Rustler," was the proprietor of the Stockgrowers' Journal and a frequent visitor to Medora from 1885. He attended the stockmen's meeting at Medora in April 1885 and the Little Missouri River Stockgrowers' Association meeting in April 1886.

moments.label: Called proprietor of the Stockgrowers' Journal
Attended the Little Missouri stockgrowers' meeting

mentions: S. A. Marney, of the Stockgrowers' Journal passed through Medora last week on his way to Miles City.

A number of cowmen from the west and south were in attendance at the meeting yesterday. Among them we noticed H. S. Boice, Geo. Towers, Pierre Wibaux, Griffin & Ward, Mr. Rowe, J. N. Simpson and all the stockmen tributary to Medora.
S. A. Marney, of the Stockgrower's, attended the meeting here yesterday.

S.A. Marney, the rustler and proprietor of the Stockgrowers' Journal, was here Saturday.
"Rustler" Marney, of the Stockgrowers Journal, made us a visit Monday. Where he can't get business, it is useless for others to try.
